integrity: Proof uses direct block linear algebra and a matching construction; deterministic verifier accompanies the claim. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The count is for individual square-zero elements of a three-block radical, not conjugacy classes or larger block decompositions.
Finite tests cover selected small fields and dimensions; the general proof is symbolic.
An equivalent historical rank formula under different indexing remains a bibliographic possibility.
title: Rank spectra of square-zero elements in three-block parabolic radicals
